ANMAC.name: Australian Nursing and Midwifery Accreditation Council

feeNote.en: AUD 595: Full skills assessment, if you are registered as a nurse or midwife overseas (for nurses: Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, Singapore, Spain, UK or US). AUD 395: Modified skills assessment, if you are already registered with NMBA/Ahpra or in New Zealand. Your report shows the figure for your profile.
feeNote.tr: AUD 595: Full beceri değerlendirmesi, yurt dışında hemşire veya ebe olarak kayıtlıysanız (hemşireler için: Kanada, Hong Kong, İrlanda, Singapur, İspanya, Birleşik Krallık veya ABD). AUD 395: Modified beceri değerlendirmesi, zaten NMBA/Ahpra'ya veya Yeni Zelanda'da kayıtlıysanız. Raporunuz profilinize uyan tutarı gösterir.
feeNote.zh-Hans: AUD 595：完整技能评估，适用于在海外注册为护士或助产士者（护士限：加拿大、香港、爱尔兰、新加坡、西班牙、英国或美国）。AUD 395：修改版技能评估，适用于已在 NMBA/Ahpra 或新西兰注册者。您的报告会显示适用于您情况的金额。

processingNote.en: Current wait time for the assessment to start; no completion time is stated.
processingNote.tr: Değerlendirmenin başlaması için güncel bekleme süresi; tamamlanma süresi belirtilmemiş.
processingNote.zh-Hans: 评估开始前的当前等待时间；未注明完成时间。

ANMAC.source: Ahpra / NMBA and Anmac skills assessment pages (Anmac.pdf), pp.26 and 37; no effective date stated
ANMAC.description: Assesses nursing and midwifery qualifications for Australian migration.

feeNote.en: AUD 395: Modified skills assessment, if you are already registered with NMBA/Ahpra or in New Zealand. For an enrolled nurse registered only overseas, the source document does not clearly state which assessment or fee applies -- confirm with Anmac.
feeNote.tr: AUD 395: Modified beceri değerlendirmesi, zaten NMBA/Ahpra'ya veya Yeni Zelanda'da kayıtlıysanız. Yalnızca yurt dışında kayıtlı bir enrolled nurse için kaynak belge hangi değerlendirmenin veya ücretin geçerli olduğunu açıkça belirtmiyor -- Anmac ile teyit edin.
feeNote.zh-Hans: AUD 395：修改版技能评估，适用于已在 NMBA/Ahpra 或新西兰注册者。仅在海外注册的 enrolled nurse 适用哪项评估或费用，来源文件未明确说明——请向 Anmac 确认。

AHPRA.description: Regulates health practitioners including doctors, dentists, pharmacists, physiotherapists, and psychologists.

feeNote.en: Medical Board of Australia application fee AUD 1,661 + specialist registration fee AUD 1,102 (Expedited Specialist pathway: general practice is on the accepted list). AMC, ECFMG and college fees are not published in the source.
feeNote.tr: Medical Board of Australia başvuru ücreti AUD 1,661 + uzman kaydı ücreti AUD 1,102 (Expedited Specialist yolu: aile hekimliği kabul listesinde). AMC, ECFMG ve kolej ücretleri kaynakta yayımlanmamıştır.
feeNote.zh-Hans: 澳大利亚医学委员会申请费 AUD 1,661 + 专科注册费 AUD 1,102（快速专科通道：全科医学在认可清单上）。AMC、ECFMG 及专科学院费用在来源文件中未公布。

processingNote.en: The source document states no processing time; about six months of supervised practice follows.
processingNote.tr: Kaynak belge işlem süresi belirtmiyor; ardından yaklaşık altı ay denetimli uygulama gelir.
processingNote.zh-Hans: 来源文件未注明处理时间；之后需约六个月的督导执业。

253111.source: Medical Board of Australia / Ahpra, Pathways to registration for international medical graduates: schedule of fees effective 1 August 2026

feeNote.en: Standard pathway: Medical Board application fee AUD 1,131 + limited registration fee AUD 1,102, plus the AMC clinical examination AUD 3,000 in person or AUD 3,400 online. The AMC CAT MCQ and candidate-account/PSV fees are not published in the source.
feeNote.tr: Standart yol: Medical Board başvuru ücreti AUD 1,131 + sınırlı kayıt ücreti AUD 1,102, artı AMC klinik sınavı yüz yüze AUD 3,000 veya çevrimiçi AUD 3,400. AMC CAT MCQ ve aday hesabı/PSV ücretleri kaynakta yayımlanmamıştır.
feeNote.zh-Hans: 标准通道：医学委员会申请费 AUD 1,131 + 有限注册费 AUD 1,102，另加 AMC 临床考试（现场 AUD 3,000 或线上 AUD 3,400）。AMC CAT MCQ 及候选人账户/PSV 费用在来源文件中未公布。

processingNote.en: The source documents state no processing time; 12 months of supervised practice follows.
processingNote.tr: Kaynak belgeler işlem süresi belirtmiyor; ardından 12 ay denetimli uygulama gelir.
processingNote.zh-Hans: 来源文件未注明处理时间；之后需 12 个月督导执业。

253999.source: Medical Board of Australia / Ahpra, Pathways to registration for international medical graduates: schedule of fees effective 1 August 2026; Australian Medical Council, p.33 (AMC clinical examination)
